fewer_simulations_note: Heart (Aliev-Panfilov with a scar): Simula reaches the error a from-scratch FNO gets with 64 simulations (0.88) after 5.4. Same test set and metric (raw_slot0 relL2), A u B model, full fine-tuning, random picks. Wildfire: about 2x at every level (2.3x / 2.1x / 2.0x at scratch N = 16 / 64 / 128). Tsunami: ahead only up to ~8 simulations (0.75 at 5 vs 1.09 at 8); from 16 on, scratch needs fewer. Source: model/results/pretrain_AB_s200000/deck_raw_slot0.json.
